entries.rawContent: Morning team! Hope everyone had a good weekend.
Quick coffee chat — anyone tried the new cafe on 5th?

Ok back to product. Two things we locked in this morning: first, we're going with PostgreSQL for the primary data store — Mongo doesn't give us the relational guarantees the billing module needs. Second, we're standardizing on pnpm workspaces across all packages, dropping npm. Both are final.

expected.rubric: Pass when the actual extracted candidates contain exactly 2 items of type 'decision' (one about PostgreSQL as primary data store, one about pnpm workspaces). Tolerate up to 1 additional non-decision item if it captures something concrete. Fail if there are 0 or 1 decisions, or if there are 3+ decisions. Score 1.0 on clean pass, 0.7 if 2 decisions plus 2+ extras, 0.0 otherwise.
